# `csharp_space_before_comma`

Space before a comma.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

### `csharp_space_before_comma = true`

```ini
csharp_space_before_comma = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Register(string name, int value, bool active)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(name, value, active);
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Register(string name , int value , bool active)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(name , value , active);
    }
}
```
:::

::::
